confirm.title: Confirm debugging on the phone
confirm.text: Unlock it and tap Allow in “Allow USB debugging?”. No prompt? Replug the cable.

card.noPermissions: Linux can't open the USB device. Add a udev rule for the phone's vendor and replug.

multi.parallel: Actions run on each in parallel
multi.runText: A shell command, run on each device at the same time.

rename.title: Rename device
rename.text: The name is only stored in Tether on this computer.
rename.label: Device name

udev.title: Set up udev rules
udev.text: Without a udev rule Linux only lets root open the phone. Install the packaged rules, or add one rule by hand.
udev.replug: Then unplug the phone and plug it back in. Your user may need to be in the plugdev group.

revoke.title: Reset trusted computers
revoke.text: If the phone never shows the prompt, make it forget old keys:
revoke.step3: Replug the cable and tap Retry; the prompt should appear.

empty.title: Connect a device over USB or Wi-Fi
empty.text: Plug in a phone with USB debugging on, pair one wirelessly, or start an emulator. It will appear here automatically.
empty.serverDown: The adb server isn't reachable right now. Tether keeps retrying.

disconnected.title: {{name}} disconnected
disconnected.since: waiting for it to come back. Everything below is from {{time}} and stays readable.
disconnected.waiting: waiting for it to come back.

wifi.title: Connect over Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Pair and connect an Android device over the local network.
wifi.paired: Paired — waiting for the phone to offer a connection…

qr.requirements: Android 11 or newer · same Wi-Fi network
qr.step2: Tap Wireless debugging and turn it on
qr.step3: Tap Pair device with QR code and scan
qr.waiting: Waiting for a phone to scan…

code.intro: On the phone: Wireless debugging › Pair device with pairing code. Phones broadcasting a code show up here.
code.mdnsOff: mDNS discovery is off in this adb; type the address instead.

ip.hint: IP and port from Wireless debugging. Default port for legacy tcpip is 5555.

legacy.intro: For Android 10 and older. Start with the phone plugged in by USB, then unplug once it's on Wi-Fi.
legacy.none: Plug in a phone with USB debugging on.
legacy.warning: Port {{port}} stays open to anyone on this network until the phone reboots.
